about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Get to know more about my journey and what drives my passion for technology
about.journeyText: My passion for technology started at Gikonko Technical Secondary School, where I discovered the power of code to solve real-world problems. Since then, I've been on a continuous journey of learning and growth, mastering various technologies and frameworks.
about.loveText: I'm passionate about creating elegant solutions to complex problems. I love working with modern technologies, building user-friendly interfaces, and optimizing performance. When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring new tech trends or contributing to open-source projects.
about.missionText: To leverage technology in creating innovative solutions that make a positive impact. I believe in writing clean, maintainable code and building products that not only meet technical requirements but also provide exceptional user experiences.

Skilled in building scalable systems using Node.js, React, Next.js, PHP, MySQL, MongoDB, Flutter, and blockchain technologies. Highly motivated, hardworking, and dedicated to delivering clean, beginner-friendly code and efficient digital solutions. Also experienced in graphic design, UI/UX, and remote collaborative work.
